title: Northgate Store and Online Orders — Amount of the Missed-Appointment Credit
content:
**Clause.** For a Northgate Scheduled Large-Item Delivery order of **Northgate Store and Online Orders**, the standard missed-appointment credit is one fifth (20 percent) of the large-item delivery fee charged on the order, rounded half up to the cent.

The missed-appointment credit percentage is that standard fifth together with every extra percentage on the order. The large-item delivery fee charged is multiplied once by that percentage, any flat amount on the order is added, the sum is rounded half up to the cent, and the credit never exceeds the large-item delivery fee standing on the order, that is the fee charged less refunds already booked against it. Every count of calendar days in this computation leaves out the day it starts from and includes the day it ends on.

| Input | Read from |
|---|---|
| large-item delivery fee charged | the large-item delivery fee charge on the order |
| large-item delivery fee standing | that charge less the refunds already booked against it |

**Worked figures (hypothetical).**
- A delivery fee charged at 65.00 with nothing refunded: one fifth of 65.00 is 13.00, so the credit is 13.00.
- The same fee with 60.00 already refunded against it: the fee standing is 5.00, so the credit is 5.00.
